component.name: PitaGames
component.summary: Launch and configure your Steam library

description.p: PitaGames is a game launcher for Steam on CachyOS and Arch Linux. It reads the installed Steam library directly, shows cover art, playtime and install state, and starts games through its own shim instead of a shell command line.

Per-game runtime profiles pick a Proton build, a wrapper chain (gamemode, MangoHud, gamescope) and diagnostics, then route the game through pitagames-shim from Steam's launch options. The launcher also carries the PitaGames compatibility database, anti-cheat detection with an injection gate, and a logs viewer.
Validated by the project on the Radeon RX 9070 (RDNA 4) and RX 5700 XT (RDNA 1) only; other GPUs are shown as experimental and not tested by us.
First packaged build: Steam library, runtime profiles, compat database, logs and desktop integration.
